limitations: Mean OEWS job wage multiplied by broader ECEC group total/wage ratio is a declared transfer, not a joint observation, local price or matched53ft carrier calibration.
Different source periods are retained without implicit inflation or a service-date claim. Other geography, fleet size and compensation contracts require review.
Benefits are a total planning envelope, not individual tax or bonus microvalues. Do not add FICA, workers compensation, retirement, premiums or ATRI bonuses a second time.

Assigned hourly position, paid breaks and synchronization wait are declared operating hypotheses; no actual payroll guarantee, paid waiting contract, ELD or weekly labor/HOS compliance is established.
Ordinary recovery rest/sleeper time is not multiplied by hourly wage. Away-time blocks remain a separate meal/incidental quantity.
IRS amount is a public substantiation reference transferred into a declared employer allowance, not a required reimbursement, market-average meal bill or lodging price.
Started24h assignment blocks are a planning expense policy, not real calendar first/last-day tax allocation. No80percent deduction, tax benefit or tax eligibility is inferred.

Reference assumes sleeper cab, no routine hotel, no extraordinary travel or on-call compensation. Actual required lodging, changing driver assignments or guarantee contracts need a new applicable scope, not automatic zero.
No MX remuneration/admin/asset costs are included. The old mileage aggregate, including its unsplit per diem, is replaced wholly rather than retained alongside this allowance.
A documented complete component under these ordinary planning assumptions does not establish a complete D2D estimate or production quote readiness.
